cutoff-reservation-clock.basis: the cutoff is the INTENT's New York date, not the reservation clock's

deadline-intent-ge-to-gt.basis: SLOT-INTENT at now == E must be REFUSE; '>' appends

deadline-missed-lt-to-le.basis: MISSED must commit at now == E; '<=' refuses it

deadline-qualified-ge-to-gt.basis: R == D must not seal; '>' lets QUALIFIED commit (killer renamed/moved: map)
deadline-qualified-ge-to-gt.source_line: assert got == ["SLOT-INTENT"] and not sealed and rep["journal"]["outcome"] == "REFUSE"

deadline-timeout-lt-to-le.basis: TIMEOUT must commit at now == D; '<=' refuses it (the finalizer defers, no row)

erratum-blocked-close-rederived.basis: a valid BLOCKED CLOSE closes A from the mailbox alone (zero open trials) (pytest.raises oracle; B3: a DID-NOT-RAISE Failed here is a kill)

erratum-finalizer-takes-work-lock.basis: no slot work lock before the last finalizer decision
erratum-finalizer-takes-work-lock.source_line: assert not any(ev[0] == "lock" and ev[1].startswith("slot-") for ev in events[:decided[-1] + 1])

erratum-non-official-close-counts.source_line: assert sorted(x.mailbox_id for x in t.scan(mb)) == official      # E4.2: no other line is a candidate

erratum-seal-ignores-close.basis: a CLOSE between the reads refuses PREPARED
erratum-seal-ignores-close.source_line: assert kinds_ == ["STAGE-INTENT"] and only.closed is not None                 # PREPARED refused (CLOSED)

erratum-stop-fence-removed.basis: TRIAL-STOP must be refused while a determined close has no CREATED seal
erratum-stop-fence-removed.source_line: assert res.outcome == "REFUSE" and "not sealed" in res.reason

omitted-check-journal.basis: verify_ack must refuse on check_journal problems (pytest.raises oracle; B3: a DID-NOT-RAISE Failed here is a kill)
omitted-check-journal.source_line: with pytest.raises(t.Refusal, match=reason):                # verify_ack refuses on check_journal problems

omitted-envelope-input.basis: the envelope inputs must include opening_books.json

omitted-evidence-manifest.basis: a wrong E5.5 manifest hash must be INVALID (registration-artifact) (pytest.raises oracle; B3: a DID-NOT-RAISE Failed here is a kill)

omitted-verify-ack-field.basis: a differing ACK field must refuse with the 'differ from the current artifacts' text (pytest.raises oracle; B3: a DID-NOT-RAISE Failed here is a kill)

owner-4a-actor-removed.basis: a foreign-actor QUALIFIED must be INVALIDATE contradictory-completion

owner-recovery-own-op.basis: recovery must append CREATED with the stage's own op

owner-timeout-op-removed.basis: a foreign-op TIMEOUT must be INVALIDATE contradictory-finalizer

r6-books-economic-in-entry-guard-dropped.basis: a missing pass refuses with the NO_PASS text (pytest.raises oracle; B3: a DID-NOT-RAISE Failed here is a kill)

r6-books-economic-in-foreign-module.basis: exactly one fresh module per pass: another module is another verification
r6-books-economic-in-foreign-module.source_line: assert len(made) == k + 1, f"pass {k}: {len(made) - k} verifications (want exactly 1, fresh)"

r6-books-fifo-prefix-off-by-one.basis: the pass-scoped replay equals the public sold_events

r6-books-sold-events-entry-guard-dropped.basis: a missing pass refuses with the NO_PASS text (pytest.raises oracle; B3: a DID-NOT-RAISE Failed here is a kill)

r6-books-sold-events-foreign-module.basis: exactly one fresh module per pass: another module is another verification
r6-books-sold-events-foreign-module.source_line: assert len(made) == k + 1, f"pass {k}: {len(made) - k} verifications (want exactly 1, fresh)"

r6-confirming-calendar-hash-unchecked.basis: a calendar not hashing to the manifest record is None

r6-diagnostic-torn-tail-not-completed.basis: an inherited torn tail is completed before this record's line
r6-diagnostic-torn-tail-not-completed.source_line: assert data == (existing or b"") + completion + _line(_rec(11)), data

r6-early-refusal-runs-finalizer.basis: a refused attempt calls no finalizer / decide_stop
r6-early-refusal-runs-finalizer.source_line: assert [x for x in w.calls if x in ("decide_stop", "finalize_close", "_after_terminal", "_finalize_others",

r6-listing-refusal-not-held-until-e55.basis: the stop-gap (publish=False) and E5.5 run before the held refusal

r6-pass-held-across-seal-stages.basis: a fresh per-close verification between seal stages
r6-pass-held-across-seal-stages.source_line: assert sims(loads[:s_], e_) == 1, (e_, s_, loads[e_:s_])      # exactly one fresh per-close verification

r6-strict-enum-nested-oserror-swallowed.basis: an enumeration failure never passes the gate
r6-strict-enum-nested-oserror-swallowed.source_line: assert isinstance(e, SystemExit), "an enumeration failure passed the gate (the stray was not seen)"

r6-typed-identity-kind-ignored.basis: a changed kind is not the same observation: refused with no row (oracle in the helper _score_refused_no_row: its own pytest.raises line)

scope-full-history-start.basis: the full-history CA family starts at full_history_start

scope-window-full-swapped.basis: the window CA family uses ca_symbols_window

stop-n-ge-to-gt.basis: exactly STOP_N (100) sold lots must stop; with '>' no lots candidate and the W slot is not terminal, so stop_record returns None
stop-n-ge-to-gt.source_line: assert rec is not None, "no stop record"           # (Deviation 3: assert, not a TypeError on None)

stop-pending-removed.basis: a pending eligible close must make stop_record None
stop-pending-removed.source_line: assert z.stop_record(gv.out, gv.rows, st_["start"], st_["calendar"], gv.trial.bundle) is None

stop-prefix-le-to-lt.basis: the sampled history is fixed at (and includes) the STOP
stop-prefix-le-to-lt.source_line: assert before == after and list(before["seals"]) == sorted(before["seals"])
